figures.label: fig:intro
figures.caption: Retrieval interface redesign. Left: free-query interface, where the policy generates a query string and receives searched documents. Right: Harness-G interface, where the policy selects a finite action ID from the menu (Select/Lookup/Answer) over a tripartite graph, and the environment constructs queries and updates retrieval state.

figures.label: fig:framework
figures.caption: Harness-G from graph construction to policy optimization. A paragraph--sentence--entity graph supports the online action menu, where the policy selects finite Select/Lookup/Answer actions and the environment performs deterministic retrieval. SNC previews same-state alternatives, scores them with frozen answerer g , and propagates enablement credit along provenance edges; GRPO combines the resulting step advantage with the outcome advantage.
